description: This file defines the MyTasksDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for displaying user-specific tasks in the SuiteCRM application. It extends the DashletGeneric class and sets up dashlet data, title, search fields, columns, and seed bean for Tasks.

classes.name: MyTasksDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying tasks assigned to the current user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the MyTasksDashlet, initializes dashlet data, title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.
